name: Memory Reuse Viewer
description: Canvas-based UB/L1/L0C tensor lifetime and memory reuse inspector. It renders buffer offset by kernel tick, peak usage, reuse links, tensor details, source snippets, and CCE snippets for hardware-map panels and future Memory.txt integrations.
useWhen: opening a UB/L1/L0C conflict and reuse analysis panel from hardware architecture diagrams
visualizing tensor lifetimes over buffer address space
showing source and CCE snippets linked to local buffer allocation windows
allowedOverrides: data buffers, tensor rows, source snippets, and CCE snippets
container framing outside the viewer root
forbiddenOverrides: writing page-local canvas renderers for the same tensor lifetime chart
mutating generated tensor rectangles directly instead of changing the data payload
using non-token colors for panel chrome outside the scoped chart semantic colors
agentReuseRule: Load pattern.css and pattern.js, then call window.PtoMemoryReuseViewer.render with Memory.txt-derived data or createDemoData for previews. Keep the viewer inside an unscaled panel; do not mount it inside a pan/zoom architecture canvas.
